hunt.justification: Protecting tenant boundaries and ensuring remote support tools are not abused is a critical security obligation as organizations adopt autonomous AI agents.

meta.name: Managed Access and Tenant Integrity

related.reason: This hunt focuses on the abuse of existing cross-tenant access, not the initial creation of shadow tenants.

meta.analysis: A single rule cannot correlate a third-party sign-in, an unattended remote support session, and autonomous script behavior. This hunt uses a phased flow to build behavioral context across identity, process, and script surfaces.

stages.name: Cross-Tenant Identity Manipulation
observables: Identity policy configuration drift in Entra ID
Sign-ins from unmanaged or third-party tenants

stages.name: Unattended Support Session Abuse
observables: Windows Unattended Support with Remote Sign-In sessions without user interaction
Unauthorized device renames via Windows Autopilot device association

stages.name: Unauthorized AI Agent Activity
observables: AI agent-initiated actions without explicit user approval
Usage of high-privilege permissions by agentic identities

stages.name: Obfuscated C2 via Multi-hop Proxy
observables: Network connections to Tor onion routing nodes
Chained proxy traffic originating from autonomous processes
Traffic to known multi-hop proxy exit points

scenario.summary: This campaign involves the compromise of cloud identity foundations and the abuse of administrative remote management features to maintain persistence. Adversaries leverage autonomous AI agents to execute unauthorized actions and employ multi-hop proxies to obfuscate command-and-control traffic across hybrid environments.

meta.rationale: The hunt begins by identifying hosts with Intune-managed support software to narrow the behavioral scope, then pivots to global identity logs.
meta.hypothesis: An adversary has established persistence via cross-tenant delegated administration or unattended remote support, subsequently deploying autonomous agents that communicate through multi-hop proxies.

hunt.name: Managed Access and Tenant Integrity
hunt.description: This hunt validates tenant boundaries and the integrity of remote access features. It identifies unauthorized cross-tenant sign-ins, abuses of Windows Unattended Support sessions, and autonomous agent behavior that uses multi-hop proxies for command-and-control. The phased flow correlates early access and persistence indicators with follow-on execution and network obfuscation.

config.scoping_notes: The hunt begins by identifying hosts with Intune-managed support software to narrow the behavioral scope, then pivots to global identity logs.

config.content: SELECT device_hostname, package_name, package_version FROM hb_software_inventory WHERE (LOWER(package_name) LIKE '%intune%' OR LOWER(package_name) LIKE '%remote help%') AND ('{{scope_hosts}}' = '' OR instr(',' || '{{scope_hosts}}' || ',', ',' || device_hostname || ',') > 0)
config.description: Find hosts where Intune or remote-support tools are installed to scope the behavior hunt.
config.expected_signal: A list of hosts running managed support software. Silence means no such software is inventoried.

primitive_config.label: Identify managed support assets
primitive_config.content: SELECT device_hostname, package_name, package_version FROM hb_software_inventory WHERE (LOWER(package_name) LIKE '%intune%' OR LOWER(package_name) LIKE '%remote help%') AND ('{{scope_hosts}}' = '' OR instr(',' || '{{scope_hosts}}' || ',', ',' || device_hostname || ',') > 0)
primitive_config.expected: A list of hosts running managed support software. Silence means no such software is inventoried.

config.content: SELECT actor_user_name, provider, COUNT(DISTINCT dst_endpoint_name) AS host_count, MIN(time) AS first_seen, MAX(time) AS last_seen FROM hb_auth_signin WHERE instr(',' || '{{third_party_providers}}' || ',', ',' || LOWER(provider) || ',') > 0 AND time >= datetime('now', '-{{lookback_days}} days') GROUP BY actor_user_name, provider HAVING host_count <= 3
config.description: Find rare sign-ins from integrated third-party providers where an adversary may operate shadow tenants.
config.expected_signal: Rare sign-ins to specific hosts from external providers. Silence means no such sign-ins were recorded.

primitive_config.label: Unusual cross-tenant sign-ins
primitive_config.content: SELECT actor_user_name, provider, COUNT(DISTINCT dst_endpoint_name) AS host_count, MIN(time) AS first_seen, MAX(time) AS last_seen FROM hb_auth_signin WHERE instr(',' || '{{third_party_providers}}' || ',', ',' || LOWER(provider) || ',') > 0 AND time >= datetime('now', '-{{lookback_days}} days') GROUP BY actor_user_name, provider HAVING host_count <= 3
primitive_config.expected: Rare sign-ins to specific hosts from external providers. Silence means no such sign-ins were recorded.

config.content: SELECT device_hostname, process_name, process_cmd_line, user_name, time FROM hb_process_activity WHERE (LOWER(process_name) LIKE '%remotehelp%' OR LOWER(process_name) LIKE '%quickassist%' OR LOWER(process_name) LIKE '%remotesignin%') AND ('{{scope_hosts}}' = '' OR instr(',' || '{{scope_hosts}}' || ',', ',' || device_hostname || ',') > 0) AND time >= datetime('now', '-{{lookback_days}} days')
config.description: Identify remote support sessions launched on endpoints, focusing on those that bypass user confirmation.
config.expected_signal: Process logs for remote support binaries. Silence suggests no such sessions occurred on the scoped hosts.

config.objective: Identify hosts where a third-party sign-in was followed by the execution of a remote support binary, citing temporal and user overlap.
config.description: Determine if third-party sign-ins correlate with unattended support activity.
config.expected_signal: A per-host verdict linking external identities to remote support persistence.
config.success_criteria: Confirm malicious or suspicious persistence indicators per host.

config.content: SELECT device_hostname, script_content, actor_user_name, time FROM hb_script_activity WHERE (LOWER(script_content) LIKE '%langchain%' OR LOWER(script_content) LIKE '%autogen%' OR LOWER(script_content) LIKE '%openai%' OR LOWER(script_content) LIKE '%agent%') AND ('{{scope_hosts}}' = '' OR instr(',' || '{{scope_hosts}}' || ',', ',' || device_hostname || ',') > 0) AND time >= datetime('now', '-{{lookback_days}} days')
config.description: Identify AI-agent framework keywords in script blocks executed after the suspected access events.
config.expected_signal: Script contents suggesting autonomous automation or agent-driven logic. Silence means no matching keywords were captured.
